items.title: Right exactness of the Chow group sequence associated with an envelope, with the cycle-level lifting claim

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives exactness at the middle term of CH_k(Y times_X Y) -> CH_k(Y) -> CH_k(X) -> 0 for an envelope f : Y -> X, the descent input for identifying CH with K_0 of the truncated coherent category (statement lines 3592-3605, tag 0GU8). Surjectivity is a direct lift along a completely decomposed proper morphism, but the kernel step needs a real construction: for each integral closed Z in X one must choose a birational model W of Z inside Y, form the unique component W'_j of W_j times_Z W mapping birationally to W_j, and verify in three separate dimension cases that the resulting cycle gamma on Y times_X Y satisfies p_* gamma = beta and q_* gamma = 0. The case analysis plus the local finiteness argument are the substance, so the claim is H2.
